notes.title: Synced Warriors Released!
notes.content:
Synced Warriors has finally been released.

I'm sorry to anyone who has been watching the store page for any incovenience caused by the uncertain release date/time. This is my first time releasing a game on steam and I was confused by the release process. It should be available now.

I hope you enjoy Synced Warriors.
